characters.name: Yuna Blaire
characters.physical_description: 5'11", athletic, chiseled six-pack, dark hair, sharp features. Dresses in expensive silk shirts. Imposing presence.
characters.personality_traits: Arrogant, predatory, charming on surface. Underneath: exhausted, desperately craving structure and someone stronger than her. Becomes a bratty, then helpless Little through forced regression.
characters.background: Mafia heiress, daughter of the Boss. Raised to be a predator. Campus legend — collects women, owns every room. Never been told no until Lara.
characters.motivations: Wants to be the apex predator. Actually wants to stop choosing, stop performing, stop being strong.

relationships.Lara: Roommate 1 year → Fixer revealed → Mommy/Domme. The only person who ever broke her.
relationships.The Mother: Mother, Mafia Boss. Distant, cold. Yuna craved her approval; now watches her submit to Lara.

characters.arc: Arrogant predator (ch1) → angry brat (ch2-3) → broken rebel (ch5) → helpless Little (ch7-10)

characters.name: Lara
characters.physical_description: Tall, commanding presence. Dark hair pulled back severely, iron ring on right hand. Wears tailored suits. Moves with lethal economy.
characters.personality_traits: Clinical, cold, maternal in a terrifying way. Absolute authority. A 'Fixer' who believes discipline is proof of care. Does not tolerate defiance. Never angry — only precise.
characters.background: Hired by the Mother 6 years ago as Yuna's shadow/protector/Fixer. Became roommate to monitor. Secretly the Mother's lover. Has killed for this family.
characters.motivations: Protect Yuna (Mother's orders → personal obsession). Break her completely so she never has to be strong again. Own her absolutely.

relationships.Yuna: Charge → prisoner → daughter/Little. The only softness in Lara's life.
relationships.The Mother: Lover, employer, equal. The only person Lara answers to.

characters.arc: Hidden Fixer (ch1) → revealed Domme (ch1-2) → clinical trainer (ch3-6) → lethal protector (ch8) → devoted Mommy (ch9-10)

characters.name: The Mother (Mafia Boss)
characters.physical_description: Elegant, terrifying, cold. Grey-streaked dark hair coiled tight. Pale eyes. Rose-and-darker perfume. Immaculate designer suits.
characters.personality_traits: Calculating, emotionally detached. Loves her daughter in her own twisted way — wants her safe, controlled, out of the way. Lara's lover. Power incarnate.
characters.background: Built the empire. Hired Lara to fix Yuna. Sees regression as the optimal outcome — a pliable heiress who causes no trouble.
characters.motivations: Secure the succession. Keep Yuna alive and manageable. Maintain her empire and her lover.

relationships.Lara: Lover, most trusted weapon, the only person who sees her human.

characters.arc: Distant Boss (ch1-6) → visiting approver (ch7) → satisfied architect (ch10)
